title: Overall system
summary: The dashboard, application service, saved data and automatic browsers work together to collect and share VAHAN reports.
note: The reviewed setup runs on one host. Browsers receive work and send results through the application service. The saved data includes filters, schedules, progress, accounts and monthly report values.
code:
flowchart TB
    U["User"] --> UI["Dashboard"]
    UI <--> APP["Application service"]
    APP <--> DATA[("Shared saved data")]
    APP <--> BROWSERS["Automatic browsers"]
    BROWSERS <--> VAHAN["VAHAN Public Report"]

title: Administration functions
summary: The main interface has three pages. Exported Reports is available to signed-in users. Filters and Settings are for administrators.
note: Filters is the middle branch and Settings is the right branch. Account controls are available to signed-in users; administrators also manage users. Website checks appear as alerts when an issue needs attention.
code:
flowchart TB ADMIN["Administration interface"] --> REPORTS["Exported Reports"] ADMIN --> FILTERS["Filters"] ADMIN --> SETTINGS["Settings"] REPORTS --> RD["Yearly table and search
Excel export
History and coverage"] FILTERS --> FD["Saved selections
Selection rules
Preview items"] SETTINGS --> SD["Schedules and progress
Pause and continue
Alerts and accounts"]

title: Filter choices and preview
summary: Some choices depend on earlier selections. The final preview combines valid selections with the administrator's rules.
note: Changing a parent choice requires its dependent choices to be checked again. Other fields include manufacturer, registration status, owner type and vehicle type. A plan can contain at most 3,000 collection items.
code:
flowchart TB
    subgraph GEO["Geography"]
        direction LR
        REGION["Region"] --> STATE["State"] --> RTO["RTO"]
    end
    subgraph VEHICLE["Vehicle selection"]
        direction LR
        GROUP["Group"] --> SUB["Subcategory"] --> CLASS["Class"]
        EV["Electric type"] --> FUEL["Fuel"]
    end
    GEO --> RULES["Include and exclude rules"]
    VEHICLE --> RULES
    OTHER["Other selected fields"] --> RULES
    RULES --> PREVIEW["Preview valid collection items"]

title: Schedule creation and repeats
summary: A schedule starts from a saved filter selection and begins when its time and operating conditions allow.
note: One-time schedules end after that run. Daily and monthly schedules wait for their next due time. Monthly repeats use month-end if the selected day is not in that month. Disabling future repeats does not pause an active run.
code:
flowchart TB
    FILTER["Saved filter selection"] --> SET["Set year time repeat and parallel limit"]
    SET --> WAIT["Wait until due"]
    WAIT --> CHECK{"Ready to start?"}
    CHECK -->|Yes| RUN["Plan items and run"]
    CHECK -->|No| REASON["Wait or show the reason"]
    REASON --> CHECK
    RUN --> FINISH["Run finishes"]
    FINISH -->|Repeating schedule| WAIT
    FINISH -->|One-time schedule| ENDING["Schedule ends"]

title: Collection and source outcomes
summary: Available browsers process different collection items within the selected limit. VAHAN's response determines the next step.
note: Each browser handles one item at a time. A report or confirmed empty result becomes complete only after it is saved. A timeout, rejected verification or reading error remains an error.
code:
flowchart TB
    LIST["Planned collection items"] --> SHARE["Assign to ready browsers"]
    SHARE --> B1["Browser 1"]
    SHARE --> B2["Browser 2"]
    SHARE --> BN["Other ready browsers"]
    B1 --> RESULT{"VAHAN result"}
    B2 --> RESULT
    BN --> RESULT
    RESULT -->|Report| FILE["Check the full Excel file"]
    RESULT -->|No records confirmed| EMPTY["Save an empty result"]
    RESULT -->|Error| RETRY["Record the reason and retry"]
    FILE --> SAVED["Saved result shown in reports"]
    EMPTY --> SAVED

title: Website check before collection
summary: The system checks every selected browser before allowing new work on the VAHAN page.
note: This check confirms that required fields and buttons can be identified. It does not prove that the source numbers are correct. Extra verification requested by VAHAN needs a separately confirmed operator workflow; the reviewed dashboard does not provide a complete form for it.
code:
flowchart TB
    READY["Selected ready browsers"] --> INSPECT["Inspect VAHAN fields and buttons"]
    INSPECT --> MATCH{"Page compatible?"}
    MATCH -->|Yes| ALLOW["Allow planning and new work"]
    MATCH -->|No| BLOCK["Block new work and show details"]
    BLOCK --> FIX["Review and correct the issue"]
    FIX --> INSPECT

title: Excel checks and saved results
summary: The system checks the downloaded workbook before saving monthly figures and marking the item complete.
note: The workbook must be readable and match the required reporting context. Blank values stay blank, reported zero stays zero, and OTHERS keeps its source label. A failed check does not become an empty result.
code:
flowchart TB
    FILE["Full Excel workbook from VAHAN"] --> CHECK["Read sheets and check year and values"]
    CHECK --> VALID{"Valid workbook?"}
    VALID -->|Yes| SAVE["Save monthly values and import history"]
    SAVE --> COMPLETE["Mark complete and update reports"]
    VALID -->|No| ERROR["Keep the item as an error"]
    ERROR --> REVIEW["Show the reason for review or retry"]

title: Report viewing and Excel export
summary: Users select the report and year, search for an office, and view the saved monthly table.
note: Excel export includes all matching rows, not only the page on screen. Administrators can compare a known plan with clean saved results. Missing items are shown, but the coverage view does not automatically collect them.
code:
flowchart TB
    PICK["Select report and year"] --> SEARCH["Search State or RTO"]
    SEARCH --> TABLE["View manufacturers and 12 months"]
    TABLE --> EXCEL["Export matching rows to Excel"]
    TABLE --> HISTORY["Review import history"]
    TABLE --> COVER["Check collection coverage"]
    COVER --> GAPS["Identify remaining items"]

title: Errors and further attempts
summary: Failed items are retried within their group, followed by a final pass for errors that remain after all new items have been processed.
note: Groups contain at least 10 items and may grow with the parallel limit. Saved results remain available. A confirmed no-data result is not retried. A finished run can still have unresolved errors.
code:
flowchart TB
    GROUP["Process the current group"] --> RETRY["Retry failed items in this group"]
    RETRY --> MORE{"More new items?"}
    MORE -->|Yes| GROUP
    MORE -->|No| FINAL["One final pass for remaining errors"]
    FINAL --> CLOSE["Finish and list unresolved items"]

title: Pause continue and connection recovery
summary: A manual pause lets active items finish. A source connection interruption keeps saved results and the unfinished work for recovery.
note: Continue checks the browsers and VAHAN page again. Manually paused runs stay paused until the user continues them. Network recovery uses the remaining work rather than collecting saved items again.
code:
flowchart TB
    RUN["Running"] --> MANUAL["User selects Pause"]
    RUN --> NETWORK["VAHAN connection lost"]
    MANUAL --> DRAIN["Stop new work and finish active items"]
    DRAIN --> PAUSED["Paused with remaining work kept"]
    PAUSED --> CONTINUE["User selects Continue"]
    NETWORK --> HOLD["Keep saved results and unfinished work"]
    HOLD --> RESTORED["Connection restored"]
    CONTINUE --> CHECK["Check browsers and page again"]
    RESTORED --> CHECK
    CHECK -->|Ready| RUN
    CHECK -->|Not ready| BLOCK["Wait or show the issue"]

title: Accounts and access
summary: The user's role decides which pages and actions are available. Authorized accounts share the saved report data.
note: Viewers can read and export reports. Administrators also configure filters and schedules and manage accounts. Passwords are stored in a protected form; access should be confirmed using customer accounts before acceptance.
code:
flowchart TB
    LOGIN["Sign in"] --> ROLE{"Account role"}
    ROLE -->|Viewer| REPORTS["Read and export shared reports"]
    ROLE -->|Administrator| ADMIN["Administrative access"]
    ADMIN --> REPORTS
    ADMIN --> FILTERS["Manage filter selections"]
    ADMIN --> SETTINGS["Manage schedules and recovery"]
    ADMIN --> USERS["Manage user accounts"]
